raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: watchfiles
  version: "1.3.0"
  python_check_max: "3.14"
  # skip rationale:
  #   cli_help                    missing a fixture
  #   ignore_permission_denied    hangs in linux CI container
  pytest_k: not (cli_help or ignore_permission_denied)

package:
  name: watchfiles
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/w/watchfiles/watchfiles-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 99aee4a07847c06820765fd7b1b49ceac4f3f711ccb7d104655a33231de1c207

build:
  number: 0
  skip: is_abi3 and not is_python_min
  script:
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
      CARGO: cargo-auditable-wrapper${{ ".bat" if win }}
      PYTHONIOENCODING: utf-8
      PYTHONLEGACYTEXTENCODING: utf-8
    content:
      - if: win
        then:
          - copy "%RECIPE_DIR%\cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat" "%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat"
        else:
          - cp "${RECIPE_DIR}/cargo-auditable-wrapper.sh" "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
          - chmod 755 "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
      - |-
        ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check --check-build-dependencies
      - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
  python:
    version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
    entry_points:
      - watchfiles = watchfiles.cli:cli

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cargo-auditable
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
  host:
    - maturin >=0.14.16,<2
    - pip
    - python
    - if: is_abi3
      then:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - python-abi3
  run:
    - python
    - anyio >=3.0.0
    - if: is_abi3
      then:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - python-abi3

tests:
  - python:
      imports: watchfiles
      pip_check: true
  - files:
      source:
        - pyproject.toml
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - dirty-equals >=0.8.0
        - pytest >=7.4.4,<9.1
        - pytest-mock >=3.14.0
        - pytest-pretty >=1.2.0
        - pytest-timeout >=2.3.1
        - if: is_abi3
          then:
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
            - abi3audit
    script:
      - watchfiles -h
      - pytest -vv --tb=long --color=yes -k "${{ pytest_k }}"
      - if: is_abi3
        then:
          - cd "${{ '$SP_DIR' if unix else '%SP_DIR%' }}/watchfiles"
          - abi3audit -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }} _rust_notify.${{ 'abi3.so' if unix else 'pyd' }}

about:
  summary: Simple, modern and high performance file watching and code reload in python.
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/watchfiles
  repository: https://github.com/samuelcolvin/watchfiles
  documentation: https://watchfiles.helpmanual.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - davidbrochart
    - samuelcolvin
    - bollwyvl
